families.name: Recognise microorganism terminology
families.distinguishing_features: Match a biological description to a microorganism term, group or associated process; this is terminology recognition, not an explanation of a mechanism.

families.name: Identify the independent variable of an investigation
families.distinguishing_features: Identify the factor varied or compared in the stated investigation rather than the measured response.

families.name: Identify the measured response of an investigation
families.distinguishing_features: Name the dependent variable from the investigation description, distinguishing the measurement from what is varied.

families.name: Specify controls that keep comparisons fair
families.distinguishing_features: Name relevant quantities or participant characteristics held the same between compared groups; do not confuse controlled variables with an untreated control group.
